DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当を食べる場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to eat your packed lunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、家族三人です。敷物を広げられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数を伝え敷物を使える場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, there are three in our family. Is there somewhere we can spread a mat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the number of people and ask where to use a mat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 奥の芝生広場をお使いください。花壇の横は作業中なので、入らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use the lawn farther in. Work is underway beside the flower bed, so please do not enter there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 芝生にします。日陰はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 芝生を選び日陰を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will use the lawn. Is there shade?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the lawn and ask about shade. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場の左側に大きな木があります。根が出ているので、敷物は少し離して広げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a large tree on the left of the square. Its roots stick out, so spread the mat a little away from it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 木から離れた所ですね。子どもの手を洗える水道もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 敷物の位置を確認し水道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Away from the tree, then. Is there a tap for washing my child's hands too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the mat position and ask about a tap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理棟の横にあります。こちらの道を進むと、右手に見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is beside the administration building. Follow this path and you will see it on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水道に寄ってから広場へ行きます。食べ終わったごみは持ち帰りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水道を経由する予定とごみの扱いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will stop at the tap before going to the lawn. We will take our rubbish home after eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the plan to go via the tap and how to handle rubbish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。広場にはカラスが来るので、食べ物を出したまま席を離れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please. Crows come to the lawn, so do not leave your place with food sitting out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。誰かが水道へ行くときも、大人が一人残ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食べ物を放置しないための行動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Even when someone goes to the tap, one adult will remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain how you will avoid leaving food unattended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、お弁当を楽しんでください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your lunch. Have a good time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、行き先を間違えて買いました。まだ改札には入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 買い間違いと改札に入っていないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I bought the wrong destination. I have not entered the gates yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the mistaken purchase and that you have not entered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切符を拝見します。どちらの駅まで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the ticket. Which station are you going to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本当は青葉駅までです。券売機で一つ手前の駅を押してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本当の行き先と押し間違えた駅を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Actually, Aoba Station. I pressed the station one stop before it on the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your intended destination and the station pressed by mistake. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの切符では百円足りません。窓口で差額をお支払いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This ticket is 100 yen short. You can pay the difference at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 百円を追加すればいいんですね。買い直す必要はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差額を確かめ買い直しが必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I add 100 yen. Do I need to buy a new ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the difference and ask whether repurchasing is necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらで変更します。変更した切符で、向こうの改札からお入りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will change it here. Use the changed ticket to enter the gates over there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。青葉駅には普通列車で行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 普通列車で目的地へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Can I reach Aoba by local train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether a local train reaches your destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、二番乗り場の普通列車に乗ってください。青葉駅は三つ目です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, take the local from platform two. Aoba is the third stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二番乗り場から普通列車で三つ目ですね。百円はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗り場と停車駅数を復唱して差額を払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The local from two, third stop. Here is the 100 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the platform and stop count and pay the difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします、変更した切符をどうぞ。お気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Here is the changed ticket. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ごみの出し方についてのご相談ですね。何を処分されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice on disposing of rubbish. What is the item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 木の机です。大きくて、普段のごみ袋には入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ごみ袋に入らない木の机を処分したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A wooden desk. It is large and does not fit in ordinary rubbish bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to dispose of a wooden desk that does not fit in rubbish bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この申込み用紙に、品物の種類と大きさをご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Fill in the item's type and size on this application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幅は九十センチですが、高さを測っていません。全部の寸法が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未測定の高さについて全寸法が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is ninety centimeters wide, but I have not measured the height. Do you need all dimensions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether all dimensions are needed, since the height is unmeasured. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この用紙は幅・奥行き・高さの欄があります。家で測ってから記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The form has width, depth and height fields. Measure at home before filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 脚を外しても机として書けばいいですか。持ち運びやすくしたいんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 脚を外す予定と記入方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I remove the legs, do I still write it as a desk? I want to make it easier to carry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss the plan to remove the legs and how to describe the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外す予定も備考欄に書いてください。収集場所は申込み後の案内で指定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write your plan to remove them in the remarks too. The collection location will be specified after application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今は玄関前に出さず、場所が決まってから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定場所が決まるまでは外に出さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will not put it outside my door now; I will wait until the location is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not put it outside until the designated place is decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、料金や収集日は受付担当から案内します。用紙の提出方法もご説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Reception staff will explain the fee and collection day. Shall I explain submitting the form too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。家で寸法を書いてから、郵送で申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法を記入した後に郵送する方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I want to fill in the dimensions at home, then apply by post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask how to post the application after entering measurements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 郵送先は用紙の裏にあります。用紙をお持ちください、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The mailing address is on the back. Take the form, and please get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 採血は終わりました。このまま座っていてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The blood draw is finished. Please remain seated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し気持ちが悪くなって、目の前が暗い感じがします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血直後の吐き気と目の前が暗い感じを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I feel a little nauseous, and it seems dark in front of my eyes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report nausea and darkening vision immediately after the blood draw. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 立たずにいてください。今、倒れそうな感じはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not stand up. Do you feel you might faint now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、ふらふらします。横になれるところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふらつきを伝えて横になれる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I feel unsteady. Is there somewhere to lie down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report unsteadiness and ask where to lie down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: すぐ横のベッドにご案内します、移るときは私が支えます。息苦しさはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take you to the bed right beside you; I will support you as you move. Are you short of breath?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 息苦しくはありません。冷や汗が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 息苦しさはなく冷や汗が出ていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: No shortness of breath. I am breaking into a cold sweat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are not short of breath but have a cold sweat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 横になっていてください。医師にも来てもらいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep lying down. We will ask the doctor to come too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。荷物が椅子の下にあるので、持ってきてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 医師の診察を了承し椅子の下の荷物を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. My belongings are under the chair; could you bring them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the doctor's examination and ask for belongings under the chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに置きました。今は起き上がらず、体の感じが変わったら教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have put them here. Do not sit up now, and tell us if how you feel changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まだ少しふらつくので、このまま横になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ふらつきが残っていると伝えて横になる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I still feel a little unsteady, so I will stay lying down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report remaining unsteadiness and stay lying down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: すぐそばにいますので、声をかけてください。では、少し休んでいてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am right here, so call me. Please rest a little.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車がなくなったとのことですね。鍵は掛けてありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing, correct? Was it locked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、鎖の鍵を掛けていました。戻ったら鎖が切られていて、自転車がありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵を掛けていたことと切られた鎖だけ残っていた状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, with a chain lock. When I returned, the chain was cut and the bicycle was gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say it was locked and describe only the cut chain remaining. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どこの駐輪場に置きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and at which bicycle parking area did you leave it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の午前九時に駅の南側の駐輪場へ置きました。午後一時にはなくなっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐輪場の位置と置いた時刻および消失に気づいた時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At nine this morning, in the parking area south of the station. It was gone at one in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the parking location, time left and time noticed missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自転車の色や形、目立つ特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell us the bicycle's color, shape and notable features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 緑色で、前にかごがあります。後ろの泥よけに黄色いシールを貼っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 緑色の車体と前かごおよび黄色いシールを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Green, with a front basket. There is a yellow sticker on the rear mudguard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the green bicycle, front basket and yellow sticker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車体の番号か、防犯登録の番号はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know the frame number or theft-prevention registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 登録の控えを持ってきました。この番号と、自転車の写真もお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 防犯登録の控えと自転車の写真を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought the registration copy. I will show this number and a photo of the bicycle too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide the registration copy and bicycle photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料を拝見します。切られた鎖は、そのまま残してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me see them. Is the cut chain still where it was?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、鎖は駐輪場に残してあります。この地図の、駅の南側のここです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鎖を残してあると伝え地図で場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I left it in the parking area. Here south of the station on this map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the chain remains and show the location on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの駐輪場ですね、お話は記録しました。ご協力ありがとうございました、帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: This parking area, correct. We have recorded your account. Thank you for cooperating; take care on the way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物のお受け取りですね。不在票はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are collecting a parcel. Do you have the delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらです。今日届いた箱を、自分で受け取りに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票を出して今日届いた箱を本人が受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here it is. I came personally to collect the box delivered today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the missed-delivery notice and say you are collecting today's box yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在票のお名前は山本葵様ですね。お名前と住所がわかる書類を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The name on the notice is Aoi Yamamoto. Show a document with your name and address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この本人確認書類でお願いします。宛名の住所と同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名と同住所の本人確認書類を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please use this identification. It matches the recipient address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show identification with the same address as the addressee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します、こちらのお荷物ですね。大きな箱ですが、そのままお持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me check; this is your parcel. It is a large box; will you take it as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩いて帰るので、持ち手が欲しいです。ひもを掛けることはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩で運ぶため箱に持ち手のひもを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am walking home, so I would like a handle. Can you tie cord around it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a cord handle to carry the box on foot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ひもをご用意できます。箱を傷めないよう、横と縦に掛けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide cord. We will tie it horizontally and vertically without damaging the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。上の「取扱注意」の表示は、隠さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取扱注意の表示を隠さないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps. Please do not hide the “Handle with care” marking on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask not to cover the handling warning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を避けて掛けました。持ち手が抜けないか、軽く持ち上げてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We tied it away from the marking. Lift it gently to see whether the handle slips out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: しっかり持てます。このまま持ち帰ります、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち手を試して持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can hold it firmly. I will take it like this. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Test the handle and say you will take it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。足元にお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You are welcome. Watch your step on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記帳機で何か表示が出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did something appear on the bankbook updating machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「窓口へお越しください」と出ました。通帳の最後のページがいっぱいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳機の表示と通帳がいっぱいな状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It said “Please come to the counter.” The last page of my bankbook is full.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the machine message and the full bankbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい通帳への繰り越しですね。通帳を拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need a new bankbook, then. May I see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。古い通帳も返してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳を渡して古い通帳の返却を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here. Can I get the old bankbook back too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hand over the bankbook and request return of the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い通帳もお返しします。新しい通帳には、続きの明細を記帳します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We return the old one too. The new one will show the following transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今月の家賃の引き落としも載りますか。明細を残しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今月の家賃引き落としの明細が載るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Will this month's rent debit be included? I want to keep the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether this month's rent debit appears. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 未記帳の明細があれば載ります。新しい通帳で日付と摘要欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If it is unprinted, it will appear. Look at the date and description columns in the new bankbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 摘要欄というのは、取引の内容が書いてあるところですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 摘要欄の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Is the description column where the transaction details are written?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the description column means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの欄です。新しい通帳と古い通帳をお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this column. Here are your new and old bankbooks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家賃の明細がありました。二冊とも持ち帰って、古いほうは家で保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家賃明細を見つけ二冊とも持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I found the rent transaction. I will take both home and store the old one at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Find the rent details and say you will take both bankbooks home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、大切に保管してください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, keep them safe. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ジャムは四百八十円です。こちらもお買い上げですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: The jam is 480 yen. You are buying this too, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚には三百八十円と書いてありました。この瓶の値段ではないんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の値札とレジ価格の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shelf said 380 yen. Was that not the price for this jar?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between shelf and checkout prices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 値札を見てきますので、瓶をお借りします。いちご味でよろしいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the shelf label; let me take the jar. It is strawberry, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、いちご味です。青いふたの瓶が並んでいた場所から取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 味とふたの色を伝えて取った場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, strawberry. I took it from where the jars with blue lids were lined up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the flavor and lid color and explain where you took it from. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三百八十円の値札は小さい瓶のものでした。こちらは内容量が二百グラムです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The 380-yen tag was for a small jar. This one contains 200 grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きさを見落としていました。小さい瓶はまだ残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: サイズの見落としを認め小さい瓶の在庫を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I overlooked the size. Are any small jars left?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge overlooking the size and ask about small-jar stock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 百グラムのいちご味ならあります。そちらに替えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is 100-gram strawberry. Would you like to switch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人で使うので、小さいほうに替えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人で使うため小さい瓶への変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I use it alone, so please change it to the smaller one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the small jar because you use it alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい瓶をお持ちしました。こちらは三百八十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have brought the small jar. It is 380 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらでお願いします。大きい瓶は取り消して、小さい瓶だけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大きい瓶を取り消し小さい瓶だけ購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This one, please. Cancel the large jar; I will only buy the small one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Cancel the large jar and buy only the small one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、小さい瓶だけでお会計します。ありがとうございました、またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will charge only the small jar. Thank you, and please come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。花壇の絵を描かれるんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you drawing the flower bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、小さな折り畳み椅子を持ってきました。ここに座ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 椅子を置いて花壇を描く許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I brought a small folding chair. May I sit here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to place a chair and draw the flower bed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そこは通路が狭いので、もう少し奥の広い場所をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The path is narrow there, so use the wider space a little farther in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あの木の横でしょうか。花壇が見える場所に座りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内された場所を指し花壇が見える希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside that tree? I would like a seat with a view of the flower bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the indicated place and request a flower-bed view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです、木の右側なら花壇がよく見えます。通路の白い線より外に椅子を置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, right of the tree you can see it well. Place the chair outside the white path line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い線の外ですね。荷物も椅子の足元にまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白線の外に椅子と荷物をまとめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Outside the white line, then. I will keep my belongings together at the chair's feet too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will keep chair and belongings outside the white line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら通る方の邪魔になりません。花壇の中には入らずに描いてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you will not block passersby. Draw without entering the flower bed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外から描きます。筆を洗う水は、あちらの水道でくめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花壇に入らず描くと伝え水をくめる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will draw from outside. Can I get water for washing brushes at that tap?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stay outside the flower bed and ask where to get water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 水をくむことはできますが、絵の具のついた水は流さずにお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may get water, but take water containing paint home rather than pouring it down the drain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ふた付きの容器に入れて持ち帰ります。では、木の右側へ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用済みの水を容器で持ち帰り指定場所へ移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take it home in a container with a lid. Then I will move to the right of the tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take used water home in a container and move to the designated place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。どうぞ、ゆっくりスケッチを楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please enjoy sketching at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符についてのご用件ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この切符を買ったのですが、行き先を押し間違えました。まだ改札には入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行き先を押し間違えたことと未入場であることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought this ticket but pressed the wrong destination. I have not entered the gates yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report pressing the wrong destination and not entering yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望の行き先はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 橋本まで行きたいです。この三百円の切符で足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 橋本へ行くと伝え、三百円の切符で足りるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are going to Hashimoto and ask whether 300 yen is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 橋本まで四百二十円です。差額の百二十円をいただけば、切符をお取り替えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hashimoto is 420 yen. With the 120-yen difference, we will exchange the ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 百二十円ですね。百円玉と十円玉二枚で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差額百二十円を確認して硬貨で払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: 120 yen, correct. I will pay a 100-yen coin and two 10-yen coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm 120 yen and pay in coins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いただきます。こちらが橋本までの切符です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Here is the Hashimoto ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。改札ではこの新しい切符だけを使えばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい切符だけを改札で使うか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Do I use only the new ticket at the gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm using only the new ticket at the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、古い切符はこちらでお預かりしました。お乗りになる前に行き先もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we have taken the old ticket. Check the destination before boarding too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 橋本までの切符になっています。では、これで改札に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正後の行き先を確認し、改札へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is now for Hashimoto. I will enter the gates with this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected destination and go to the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、どうぞお気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
